implementation.design: each admitted logical task runs as one Attempt (active, delivered, cancelRequested, AbortController, timeout and interval sets). Cancel, unmount and task replacement stop the attempt: it clears owned timers and intervals, aborts the in-flight fetch and sets active false, and every await continuation, completion timer and manual click checks the attempt before it touches UI or calls onComplete. Callbacks, language and request values are read from a latest-values ref, and the startup effect depends only on a stable content key of the request fields (templateId, templateName, inputs, intent, overrides, mode, provider, model), so callback identity, language and equivalent input objects never restart a task, while a real change replaces the attempt and resets the previous attempt's visible state. Manual View Results and the automatic timers go through one deliverOnce guard. The demo interval keeps its progress locally and is owned by the attempt. Request payload, classified failure, approval and recovery branches are unchanged; no new file, hook, store or type; the public props are unchanged
